{{Quote|The unknown world is of no lasting importance. That would have been the place Nuso Esva chose to meet with his commanders and finalize his plans for the operation. But the other one, Wroona, is where I believe Nuso Esva's agents are holding Sorro's family hostage. Possibly his entire town, considering the legend the ''Salaban's Hope'' was named for. My hope is that Sorro's family may still be alive and can be freed.|Senior Captain Thrawn, to Jorj Car'das|<ref name="Choices" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] traveled aboard [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]'' to an unknown and unremarkable terrestrial '''planet''' that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] an unremarkable [[Star/Legends|sun]] for more than five [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before returning to the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] speculated that the [[Planet/Legends|world]] was where Esva met with his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanders]] to finish their preparations for a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] against the Empire in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], a theory the senior captain shared with the former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] after the battle.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
